answer: Identity verification binds each PoA identity to a Wesolowski VDF whose output requires a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings. GPUs may run separate clones concurrently, but cannot skip the dependency between steps or compress one clone’s evaluation into parallel work; every claimed identity therefore incurs its own physical delay and compute cost. This bottleneck makes mass Sybil creation costly, setting a nadir for cheap fabrication while each legitimate voyage to the network’s harbor remains verifiable.
